title: refactor: ReportView edit mode → left-right split with DesignDrawer + complete config panel
body:
ReportView edit mode replaced the entire page with `ReportBuilder` (a hand-rolled Card+Tabs form), breaking WYSIWYG preview and diverging from the DashboardView/ListView design pattern. No ConfigPanelRenderer reuse, no auto-save, no undo/redo.

## Changes

- **New `ReportConfigPanel`** (`packages/plugin-report/src/`) — schema-driven config panel using `ConfigPanelRenderer` + `useConfigDraft`, mirroring `DashboardConfigPanel`. Seven sections covering all report-level properties:
  - **Basic** — Title, Description
  - **Data** — Data source (objectName), Row limit
  - **Filters** — FilterBuilder integration via `filter` control type (field/operator/value conditions with AND/OR logic)
  - **Group By** — SortBuilder integration via `sort` control type (field selection + asc/desc ordering)
  - **Export** — Show export/print buttons, default export format (PDF/Excel/CSV/JSON/HTML)
  - **Schedule** — ScheduleConfig embedded via `custom` render (enable/disable, frequency, time, timezone, recipients, formats)
  - **Appearance** — Show toolbar, refresh interval

- **Refactored `ReportView`** (`apps/console/src/components/`) — edit mode now opens a `DesignDrawer` (right-side Sheet, `modal={false}`) while `ReportViewer` stays visible as live preview. Schema changes flow through `editSchema` state for real-time preview, same as `DashboardView`. Available fields are derived from object schema metadata and passed to filter/sort editors.

- **`ReportBuilder` preserved** — still registered in ComponentRegistry for backward compat; just no longer used as the primary edit surface.

### Architecture alignment with DashboardView

```
ReportView (orchestrator)
├── Left: ReportViewer (schema={previewReport})  ← stays visible during edit
├── Right: DesignDrawer
│   └── ReportConfigPanel (ConfigPanelRenderer + useConfigDraft)
│       ├── Filters (FilterBuilder) + Group By (SortBuilder)
│       ├── Schedule (ScheduleConfig)
│       └── auto-save via dataSource.update() + Ctrl+S
```

### Tests
- 18 new `ReportConfigPanel` unit tests (open/close, all 7 sections, save/discard, live updates)
- All 4 existing `ReportView` integration tests pass
- All 7 existing `ReportBuilder` tests unaffected

> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>重构报表设计模式：统一为左右分屏（主区预览+右侧属性面板），与 Dashboard/ListView 设计器一致</issue_title>
> <issue_description># 问题
> 
> 报表设计模式（ReportView → Edit）当前存在与仪表盘类似但更严重的架构问题：
> 
> ## 1. 编辑模式整页替换，丧失所见即所得
> - 点击 Edit 后 `ReportView` 整页切换为 `ReportBuilder`（全屏 Card+Tabs 表单），主区预览完全消失
> - 不是"左侧预览 + 右侧属性面板"的 Drawer 模式，与 DashboardView、ObjectView 体验割裂
> 
> ## 2. ReportBuilder 完全手写，未复用 ConfigPanelRenderer
> - `ReportBuilder`（packages/plugin-report/src/ReportBuilder.tsx）用 Card + Tabs（Fields/Filters/Sections/Schedule/Export）全手写
> - 没有复用 `ConfigPanelRenderer` + `useConfigDraft` + `ConfigPanelSchema` 体系
> - 没有 undo/redo、没有 dirty 检测、没有自动保存
> - `handleSave` 只有 `console.log`，无实际持久化
> 
> ## 3. 两套 Report 设计组件互不关联
> - `ReportDesigner`（plugin-designer 包）：有画布、PropertyEditor、useUndoRedo，是打印布局设计器
> - `ReportBuilder`（plugin-report 包）：Tab 表单，面向数据报表配置
> - `ReportView` 只用了 `ReportBuilder`，`ReportDesigner` 完全未集成
> - 导致产品中报表配置体验极度分散
> 
> ## 4. 深色模式 / 移动端 / 协议对齐问题
> - `ReportBuilder` 使用 `Card`, `CardHeader` 等带硬编码浅色样式（如 `bg-blue-50/50`, `text-blue-900`）
> - 无触摸设备适配、无响应式 Drawer
> - 表单字段和 @objectstack/spec ReportSchema 协议对齐不完整
> 
> # 目标
> - `ReportView` 编辑模式改为 DashboardView 一致的"左侧实时预览 + 右侧属性 Drawer"模式
> - 右侧 Drawer 复用 `ConfigPanelRenderer` + `useConfigDraft` 体系
> - 未选中组件时显示 ReportConfigPanel（报表级属性：标题、数据源、过滤、分组、导出设置...）
> - 选中 section/field 时切换为对应 FieldConfigPanel（字段级属性）
> - 主区保持 `ReportViewer` 渲染，属性改动即时反映
> - 保存通过 `DesignDrawer` 的 auto-save 机制持久化到后端
> - 统一 undo/redo、dirty 检测、save/discard
> 
> # 技术建议
> - 仿照 `DashboardView` + `DesignDrawer` 的架构改造 `ReportView`
> - 新建 `ReportConfigPanel`（报表级 ConfigPanelSchema）替代 `ReportBuilder` 的 Tab 表单
> - 复用 `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardConfigPanel.tsx` 的模式
> - `ReportDesigner`（布局设计器）可作为高级模式入口，但默认配置体验走 ConfigPanel
> 
> # 验收标准
> - ReportView 编辑模式为左右分屏，右侧固定属性面板，主区所见即所得
> - 所有属性配置走 ConfigPanelRenderer，行为和 Dashboard/ListView 完全一致
> - 保存/撤销/undo-redo/auto-save 全部正常工作
> - 深色模式、iPad 触摸设备体验完整
> - E2E 测试覆盖
>
